value.method: Source comparison, not a claim of fresh re-encoding all 230 multi-group RGB8 images. The independently encoded typed-palette-034 streams remain the correct byte reference for this unchanged path.
findings: 034 to050: hybrid log2 replacements are integer-equivalent within the validated32-bit domain; exported helpers and optional ANS scratch retain the old Modular call behavior; yield throttling changes scheduling only.
034 to050: new ANS context-map branch requires length>4096. Modular trees allow at most128 ordinary leaves or18 gradient leaves, plus one LZ77 context, so that branch cannot affect this path.

050 to054: scalarSearch requires rgb16 and is false for every rgb8 corpus source. RCT extraction is the same arithmetic with default offset0; added transform fields are absent for rgb8 and the old header fields are unchanged.

050 to054: buildEntropyPlan predictor change belongs to the single-group path. All ten affected single-group corpus records are replaced by final054 encodes. Multi-group encodeGroupCandidate keeps its existing residual-plan and gradient search.

The full exported weighted-predictor class body is byte-identical between the034 source snapshot and current source. Encoder-memory, forward-transform, quantization and ICC module hashes also match the034 report. JPEG helper changes belong to the VarDCT path, which Modular lossless encoding does not call.
value.scope: 230 multi-group RGB8 cases only. RGB16 scalar palettes and ten single-group cases use their separately measured current outputs.

historicalProtocol.cohort: All 120 frozen Imazen development source families, no replacements or exclusions after encoding
historicalProtocol.preprocessing: Sharp/libvips dev oracle converts embedded-profile source samples to sRGB RGB8, retaining the stored raster dimensions without resize or auto-orientation. All source alpha is independently audited fully opaque; RGB comparison omits that constant channel. Metadata is stripped identically for every compressor. Original display orientation remains recorded, not applied. This normalized 8-bit SDR subset does not qualify native high-depth or transparent-source gates.
historicalProtocol.performance: Concurrent size and exactness evaluation; elapsed times and process memory are observational, not isolated performance evidence.

value.policy: Current typed-palette reference for all multi-group RGB8 streams, final single-group replacements. Reuse a previous exact decode only when complete repository source, encoded hash, sample hash and sample count match. Decode every changed stream with the corrected verifier. Keep the original receipt and current-reference revalidation separate.

policy.concurrency: One fixed user-service name admits only one complete benchmark tree at a time
